title: 基本操作｜遞迴：階乘
question:
n!（n 的階乘）= n × (n − 1) × … × 1，而且 0! = 1。
請寫一個有回傳值的模組 fact(n)：n 是 0 就回傳 1，不然就回傳 n * fact(n - 1)。模組自己執行自己，叫做遞迴；一定要有一個不用再執行自己的情況（這裡是 n 是 0），才停得下來。
主流程輸入 n（0 到 12），輸出 fact(n)。
想想看：fact(3) 會再執行哪些 fact？

test_case.note: 不用再執行自己的情況
int 放得下的最大階乘

en.title: Basics | Recursion: factorial
en.question:
n! (n factorial) = n × (n − 1) × … × 1, and 0! = 1.
Make a module fact(n) that returns a value: if n is 0, return 1; if not, return n * fact(n - 1). A module that runs itself is recursion. It needs a case that does not run itself (here, n is 0), or it never stops.
In the main flow, input n (0 to 12) and output fact(n).
Think: which fact calls does fact(3) make?

test_case.note: The case that does not call itself
The biggest factorial that fits in an int
